title: teucrium joannis
intro: Teucrium joannis, commonly known as the Ionian germander, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family, native to the Ionian Islands. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which can contribute to improved overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Teucrium joannis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-cancer properties, and act as a neuroprotective agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
